title: paspalum mauritanicum
intro: Paspalum mauritanicum, commonly known as Bahama grass or Mauritius grass, is a species of grass native to tropical and subtropical regions. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve insulin sensitivity, due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Therapeutically, Paspalum mauritanicum has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Paspalum mauritanicum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
